svg.title: Curvature of AGKK’s transformation across each zone
svg.desc: Second difference of the transformed coordinates along each lattice row, per easting column, on a logarithmic scale. Zones K5 and K7 are flat at about half a millimetre and two and a half millimetres respectively. Zones K3 and K9 are equally flat except for a single spike reaching about 100 and 130 millimetres exactly at the 24 degrees east meridian.
